final: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT "ANA Pattern" AS pattern, AVG("aCL IgG") AS avg_igg FROM Examination GROUP BY "ANA Pattern"), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS mean_avg FROM group_averages), kept AS (SELECT pattern, avg_igg, avg_igg - overall.mean_avg AS above_all_mean FROM group_averages CROSS JOIN overall WHERE avg_igg > overall.mean_avg) SELECT pattern, avg_igg, above_all_mean, avg_igg - (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) FROM kept) AS from_kept_mean FROM kept ORDER BY avg_igg DESC
